### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template: `DATA_ROOT` is the results directory given to `depictio ingest`, the others are set with `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | The chipseq --outdir (one directory per aligner, fastqc/, trimgalore/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/), with the MultiQC parquet under multiqc/narrow_peak/multiqc_data/ or multiqc/broad_peak/multiqc_data/, or multiqc/multiqc_data/ for a reprocessed run. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): merged-library id (or sample group) in METADATA_ID_COL, one column per factor. GROUP_COL becomes the condition column of the design hub; the other factors are carried as extra columns. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table id column. Auto-detected as the first column. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design table factor the run compares, carried as the condition column. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC assembly the run was aligned to (hg38, hg19, mm10, ...). Sets the genome axis of the Locus tab from that assembly; left empty, the axis is built from the contigs of the peak calls, which suits any reference. |
| `PRESEQ_RAN` | — | Set to true for a run made with --skip_preseq false. The Signal tab then counts distinct fragments with preseq instead of reading the Picard duplication rate in the same slot. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py) | Per-sample deepTools fingerprint metrics, one row per library. | `sample`, `auc`, `synthetic_auc`, `auc_ratio`, `x_intercept`, `synthetic_x_intercept`, `elbow_point`, `synthetic_elbow_point`, `synthetic_js_distance` |
| [`deeptools/plot_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/plot_profile.py) | deepTools metagene profile in long form, one row per sample and bin. | `sample`, `group`, `bin`, `bin_label`, `signal` |
| [`deseq2/qc_sample_dists.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deseq2/qc_sample_dists.py) | The DESeq2 QC sample-distance matrix the pipeline already computed. | `sample` |
| [`homer/annotate_peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/annotate_peaks.py) | Tidy HOMER ``annotatePeaks.pl`` output into a per-peak annotation table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `peak_score`, `annotation_class`, `annotation`, `distance_to_tss`, `nearest_promoter_id`, `gene_name`, `gene_type` |
| [`homer/tss_distance_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/tss_distance_profile.py) | Where each sample's peaks sit relative to the nearest TSS, pre-binned. | `sample`, `distance_to_tss`, `peak_count`, `fraction` |
| [`macs2/consensus_boolean.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/consensus_boolean.py) | Consensus peak x sample presence matrix from MACS2 consensus boolean tables. | `peak_id`, `consensus_set`, `interval_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `num_peaks`, `num_samples` |
| [`macs2/consensus_fc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/consensus_fc.py) | Fold-enrichment matrix of the strongest MACS2 consensus peaks. | `peak_id`, `consensus_set`, `interval_id`, `chr`, `region`, `support` |
